for i in $(seq 1 60); do ot-ctl txpower 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 0
for i in $(seq 1 60); do ot-ctl txpower 20 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 0

url: https://s3.clerici.tech/_/health
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
  - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 240h"
client:
  dns-resolver: udp://${K8S_GATEWAY_CLUSTER_IP}:53

modules:
  http_2xx:
    prober: http
    timeout: 5s
    http:
      valid_http_versions: ["HTTP/1.1", "HTTP/2.0"]
      follow_redirects: true
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  icmp:
    prober: icmp
    timeout: 5s
    icmp:
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  tcp_connect:
    prober: tcp
    timeout: 5s
    tcp:
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
  dns_udp:
    prober: dns
    timeout: 5s
    dns:
      query_name: "google.com"
      query_type: "A"
      transport_protocol: udp
      preferred_ip_protocol: ip4
